goalbuddy_receipt_v1.summary: The smallest correct revision adds an explicit M-held input to the existing stage gesture controller and replaces direct-scope matching with deepest-match normalization over all visible selectable descendants of the frozen scope. Shift remains additive at pointerdown. M is ignored in editable/modal/composing contexts and cleared on keyup, blur, or hidden visibility, cancelling an active marquee. Deep normalization must cover the additive union so an old ancestor cannot coexist with a new descendant. Existing highlighting, operation gates, dirty/history, and serialization support cross-parent inspection.

evidence.finding: The gesture controller currently starts marquee for every eligible ordinary empty press and has no M input.
No M shortcut exists; global lifecycle already centralizes Space, dialogs, editable targets, and stage cancellation.
commitMarquee currently filters to direct children of the frozen scope, which collapses nested artwork to wrapper groups.
Focused direct-child assertions must become deepest-match, cross-parent, additive-normalization, hidden/locked, history, and byte-stability proofs.

facts.value: Hold physical KeyM to arm; Shift+M is additive; Cmd/Ctrl/Alt, composing, editable, and modal contexts do not arm.
M keyup, window blur, or hidden visibility disarms and cancels pending/active marquee without touching Space/middle pan.
Match all selectable descendants in DOM order, then remove any matched ancestor containing another matched node.
Normalize the complete frozen-selection plus new-match union so ancestors and descendants never coexist.
